summary: Clients long-poll for catalog and stream events through bounded per-subscription queues.

steps.action: expire subscriptions not polled for 60 s; reject beyond 64 subscriptions
create a 128-event queue in catalog or streams scope, optionally for one session
queue current session snapshots for this subscriber only
long-poll: wait up to timeoutMs (1 to 20,000), return up to maxEvents (1 to 256)
properties: waiting polls are futures, not threads

steps.action: on overflow, replace the backlog with a single subscription.lagged marker; client resynchronizes from a fresh list
